verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no n8n retention settings, execution-data pruning, or deletion controls. Self-hosting (n8n-docs-3) gives control over where data lives, not how long it is kept, so it is adjacent. The community note that n8n 'keeps all historical executions' describes retention behavior, not a user control. The API playground warning that users 'can change or delete real data' concerns test isolation, not a retention or deletion feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
